BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

3. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   B. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   D. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   C. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.

5. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   B. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   C. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

10. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   B. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   C. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   C. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Procurement as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   C. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Marketing as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.

15. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   B. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   D. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Savings and Investments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer and Investor Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Regulators in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Planning and Development in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
